subject: PSP + ISV co-sell: marketplace integration & billing hooks
messages:
From: Lina Moreno <lina@payflow.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PayFlow <> Redwood: PSP integration for marketplace listing (spec attached)

Hi Jasmine / Alex,

Thanks again for taking a look. PayFlow is an independent payments provider (card + tokenized payment methods) and we have a handful of ISV partners (including Acme Analytics) who want to offer a bundled solution via cloud marketplaces. We believe a joint listing / co-sell with Redwood is a good fit: Redwood handles inference + metering while PayFlow handles payment capture and settlement for bundled offers.

Attached is a short integration spec (psp_integration_spec.pdf) showing:
- billing webhook events (usage, invoice)
- tokenized payment flow for private-offer purchases
- sample SKU mapping suggestions

High-level asks:
1) Can Redwood confirm marketplace metering hooks and where PayFlow would need to connect (AWS/GCP/Azure)?
2) Any precedent for private-offer + external PSP handling on the marketplace?
3) Are there specific evidence items / certs required for co-sell listing?

We'd love a 30-min sync to align on next steps and owners. We're available 4/26 between 11:00-12:30 PT.

Attachments: psp_integration_spec.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Lina Moreno
Head of Partnerships
PayFlow Systems
lina@payflow.io
(attachments: psp_integration_spec.pdf)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Lina Moreno <lina@payflow.io>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PayFlow <> Redwood: PSP integration for marketplace listing (spec attached)

Lina — thanks for the spec and context. High level: sounds promising. Key things we'll need to align on quickly so we can scope a co-sell listing and a private-offer flow:

- Marketplace metering hook: Redwood's runtime emits SKU-level usage events; for marketplace listings we map those to a provider SKU. PayFlow would need to subscribe to settlement events or consume invoices via SFTP/API depending on the cloud (we usually provide a webhook endpoint for partner billing adapters).
- Private-offer flow: we've done private offers with external PSPs before but the marketplace (esp AWS) requires a documented escrow/settlement plan and a signed POA.
- Evidence: SOC2 report, PII handling statement, and joint SLA are commonly required for co-sell.

Propose a 30-min sync 4/26 at 11:00 PT. Internal attendees: Alex (integrations lead), Ben (partnerships), Connor (marketplace ops).

Action items for the call:
- Lina: brief demo of tokenized flow + rough timelines
- PayFlow: share the technical contact for webhook setup
- Redwood: share marketplace entry checklist + initial SKU mapping template

I'll attach our checklist during the call; in the meantime, Ben — can you pull the MVP co-sell plan template and add our suggested owners?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
(attachments: none yet)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-25T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: PayFlow integration — initial owners & checklist

All — quick internal note before the sync: I pulled together an MVP co-sell plan (mvp_co-sell-plan.xlsx) and a short checklist for marketplace intake. Key items we should confirm on the call:

- Marketplace SKU mapping owner: Alex
- Metering telemetry contract: Runtime/Telemetry team (Connor owns provider mappings)
- Evidence binder owner (SOC2, security questionnaire): Security team; Jasmine to confirm escalation path for fast-track AO
- Billing adapter: PayFlow needs an API endpoint and test sandbox — Alex to confirm API contract (Auth: tokenized bearer + client cert)

Proposed sprint: 3 sprints (discovery + integration + listing readiness). We can fast-track discovery to unblock a private-offer pilot if PayFlow has a sandbox.

Attaching: mvp_co-sell-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet) and a short marketplace intake checklist (aws_partner_entry_checklist.md).

Ben Carter
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
(attachments: mvp_co-sell-plan.xlsx, aws_partner_entry_checklist.md)

Subject: Re: PayFlow <> Redwood: PSP integration for marketplace listing (spec attached)

Thanks team — looping in from the ISV side. We at Acme can support tokenized billing and will surface our procurement contact for private-offer paperwork. A couple quick notes:

- We need clarity on the SKU granularity. If you propose per-inference-hour + premium feature flags, we can emit usage events from our side too so Redwood and PayFlow can reconcile.
- For private-offer purchases, we prefer direct invoice handoffs (PayFlow acts as subprocessor) — is there a recommended flow for the marketplace?
